# Post-installation troubleshooting and recovery {#installing-post-tnf}

You can troubleshoot and restore  a two-node OpenShift Container Platform cluster with fencing (TNF) after a disruption event. Manually recover services when automated recovery is unavailable, replace degraded control plane nodes, and use the `fencing_validator` script to verify cluster health.

**Additional resources**

- [Restoring etcd from a backup](/backup_and_restore/control_plane_backup_and_restore/backing-up-etcd#backup-etcd-restoring_backing-up-etcd)
- [Verifying etcd health in a two-node OpenShift cluster with fencing](/installing/installing_two_node_cluster/installing_tnf/install-post-tnf#installation-verifying-etcd-health_install-post-tnf)
